method: design/bal/FIXC-TRANSLATION.md section 6; sets file balance/scans/fixC-r23-sets.json (applied to authors2026, like fixC-step1.json); faithful-law variant balance/scans/fixC-r23-sets-faithful.json
sourceStats: Per run then group median over the same 290 / 289 / 290 groups as fixC-translation.json; AIFM series re-streamed (scratch r23_extract.py): progress, horizon_lengths (80%), software_efficiency at the METR dates

h50Accel.source: AIFM doubling_difficulty_growth_factor d, per run A = 1 - d, group median (ac_anchor.py _make_decaying_horizon_observable: horizon = H0 (1 - A (p - p0)/T0)^(ln2/ln(1-A)))

h50PerOOM.status: fitted to the METR history bands (A fixed)

faithful.source: AIFM present_doubling_time x anchor_progress_rate (T at the horizon date 2026.27) + A x (AIFM progress 2026.27 - progress at V0 2025.445), per run, group median: the AIFM curve re-anchored to the game V0 (203 min)
faithful.aifmLocalDoublingAtHorizonDate: T = Tp - A*xp, xp (OOM V0 to 2026.27) 1.38

h50PerOOM.fitNote: the faithful value puts the game median h50 at 2026.27 at 382 / 423 / 399 min, below the band low 509 (the player lab releases only +0.71 OOM by then, AIFM +1.15-1.29); the fit puts it at 557-567 (low edge +9-11%) with one number per timeline

horizonLaw.aifmH50OnOwnSeries: median 5 x h80 at 2025.62 / 2025.96 / 2026.13 / 2026.27: see design doc section 6

gameMeasured.note: continuous software stack (stacksGEquiv), median of 4 seeds
